Who I Am

Engineering
Healthcare

I'm a dedicated third-year Biomedical Engineering student at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, with a CGPA of 9.42/10 — passionate about medical devices and healthcare innovation that directly improves patient outcomes.

Currently serving as Healthcare Domain Head at Aakash Research Labs, I lead a project team focused on innovation in medical technology and also manage student affairs at the Directorate of Student Affairs (DSA).

My internship at Sri Narayani Hospital & Research Center gave me hands-on clinical experience with medical equipment, maintenance, and hospital safety standards.
